description_html:
A charming third floor one bedroom apartment with a south aspect overlooking the Podium planters. The property has an original Barbican kitchen and is open plan to the reception room with a full height, full width window and sliding door to the balcony. The bedroom also has floor to ceiling windows and a fitted cupboard. Extended lease.

Close-by amenities include a full size Waitrose, a Marks and Spencer food and clothing store, a weekly food market on Whitecross Street along with a good selection of restauarnats and five star hotels in the City.

The Barbican Arts Centre has three cinema screens, a members lounge and bar, concert hall, library, conservatory and restaurants overlooking the lakeside terrace.

Residents have use of communal gardens, parking and storage cages are available by separate negotiation, there is also 24 porterage in the car parks.

The apartment has exceptional transport links. Placing you within walking distance of Barbican, Moorgate, Farringdon and St Pauls stations. Offering easy access to the Elizabeth line, Circle, Hammersmith and City, Northern and Metropolitan lines.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £4,866 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: D
